conventions.arithmetic: exact integers; a probability is a reduced integer fraction; equality x/y = u/v is decided by x*v = u*y; no floating point anywhere in the verdict path
conventions.probability_encoding: format c1-reduced-rational of C1-OUTPUT-SCHEMA.json, unsigned; a JSON number in a probability field is a schema violation
conventions.state_encoding: s = v + n*h with v = s mod n the visible value and h = s div n the hidden value; n = |C_V|, m = |C_H|
conventions.orbit_representative: the least state index in the orbit; orbits listed in increasing representative; cycle listed from rep in phi order
conventions.row_order: rows and columns of every matrix are visible values 0..n-1; a matrix is a map from row (decimal string) to a list of n probability strings
conventions.permutation_test: M is a permutation matrix on row set W iff every entry M(a,j), a,j in W, is 0 or 1; every row sum over W and every column sum over W is 1; and M(a,j) = 0 for a in W, j not in W
conventions.first_mismatch: the lexicographically least (a, j), a-major, a a visited row, j in 0..n-1, with T_alpha(a,j) != the compared credence (T_beta for R0 and S1, T_beta_long for S2, T_beta_c4 for S3)
conventions.ell_min_rule: ell_min = n + 1; an orbit is long iff its length >= ell_min
conventions.long_c4: long and T_alpha not a permutation matrix on V_O; Long' is the set of such orbits (S1, S3)
conventions.T_beta_long: for a in the union of V_O over long orbits: sum over long O of c_O(a,j) / sum over long O of n_a(O) (S2); the empty map when no orbit is long
conventions.T_beta_c4: the same over Long' (S3); the empty map when Long' is empty
conventions.variants: R0: candidates Long, credence T_beta; S1: Long', T_beta; S2: Long, T_beta_long; S3: Long', T_beta_c4 (PREREG-C1.md section 4.1)
conventions.pdiv: PDivisible N Gamma of CausalReadback.lean:54 on the stated row set; alpha: rows V_O, N = |O|; beta: rows C_V, N = ord(phi); computed by Lemma PD on every toy and native instance and also by the certified definitional method of PREREG-C1.md section 2.4 on every toy
conventions.pdiv_lp_indexing: row set W = (w_0..w_{k-1}) ascending; x_{i*k+j} = Lambda(w_i, w_j); constraint rows ai*k+j: sum_i Gamma_s(w_ai,w_i) x_{i*k+j} = Gamma_t(w_ai,w_j); then rows k^2+i: sum_j x_{i*k+j} = 1; pairs (s,t) in lexicographic order, stopping at the first infeasible pair
conventions.verdicts: FREQ | FREQ_VACUOUS | NOT | VOID_NO_ORBIT per instance, for each of R0, S1, S2 and S3 (PREREG-C1.md section 4.1); overall FREQ_ALL | NOT_ALL | MIXED | VACUOUS_ALL | VOID_ALL (section 4.2)
conventions.shared_rows: per variant: the number of rows a visited by some candidate on which the variant's credence pools orbits from two or more twin classes; the pool is every orbit of S visiting a for R0 and S1, and the candidates visiting a for S2 and S3; twin classes are orbits with the same primitive_word, the least rotation of the primitive root of the orbit's cyclic visible word read from rep in phi order (PREREG-C1.md section 2.7); the frozen symmetry_generators are a cross-check only (every generator must map each orbit to an orbit with the same primitive_word, exit 4 otherwise); a match with shared_rows = 0 is FREQ_VACUOUS; a NOT with shared_rows = 0 exits 4
conventions.cert_checker: rebuilds A and b from Gamma_s and Gamma_t (never from the certificate); checks shape first (lambda: exactly the rows of W, k entries each; farkas: exactly k^2+k entries); then evaluates every clause: lambda nonnegative, row_sums, equality; farkas ATy_nonnegative, bTy_negative; valid iff no clause fails; failed clauses listed in the order shape, nonnegative, row_sums, equality, ATy_nonnegative, bTy_negative

wave_rule.step: for every site i, simultaneously: prev'_i = cur_i; cur'_i = (cur_{i-1} + cur_{i+1} - prev_i) mod q, indices mod L
wave_rule.region: R = {0, ..., r-1}, contiguous, r <= L/3; visible = the (prev, cur) pairs on R, n = q^(2r); hidden = the pairs off R, m = q^(2(L-r)); so v = s mod n and h = s div n
wave_rule.implementations: (i) the site loop above; (ii) the linear map F = [[0, I], [-I, A]] on (prev, cur) in (Z/q)^(2L), A the circulant ring adjacency; both must agree on every state of S

symmetry_generators.reflect0: sigma: (sigma x)_i = x_{-i mod L} on both components; on digits delta_i -> delta_{-i}; commutes with phi because i -> -i maps {i-1, i+1} onto {-i+1, -i-1}; fixes the visible value exactly when r = 1 (R = {0}); frozen for r = 1 only, as a cross-check generator: twin classes are defined by primitive visible words, not by this group (PREREG-C1.md section 2.7)
